message: The day after Operation "Green Grass Belongs to Everyone" wrapped up without a hitch.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, everyone's here！」
All five students of Takamura Class are properly gathered here from the morning. Just that alone makes me weirdly happy.

name: Asahi
message: 「Good morning, Iori-sensei. I look forward to your instruction starting today.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmph~, must be tiring acting like a goody-two-shoes today too~」

name: Asahi
message: 「I am merely observing the proper etiquette owed to a teacher. Were you unaware of that？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh~？ You picking a fight with me again~？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey Sensei, forget about Kijo, hurry up and teach me Jindou already♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I want Sensei to train with me more!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Speaking to Iori-sensei in such a manner is disrespectful. Do you have no intention of correcting your attitude even slightly？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「God, you're so nagging~, I wasn't even asking you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I am saying that is no attitude for someone seeking instruction.」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, you two, cut out the fighting already. I want to talk to everyone.」

name: Asahi
message: 「My apologies. I have wasted Iori-sensei's precious time on account of a foolish and ignorant student.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey you~, watch the way you phrase things!」
Oof, Asahi and Ririmu have the worst compatibility in all of Takamura Class.
I wish they'd get along, though... For now, let's just move on with class.

name: Iori
message: 「Now then, moving on... First, as a bit of a review as well, let me explain the roadmap to everyone！」

name: Iori
message: 「First up are the midterm exams in one month. Getting everyone to pass these is our top priority.」

name: Iori
message: 「There are three main parts to the exams. First, the written exams for regular subjects.」

name: Iori
message: 「Then there's the kata demonstration evaluation, and finally, the practical combat evaluation.」
The ones making sour faces are the two who failed the quiz. I thought it'd only be Ririmu, but... Setsugekka too?！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh~... Even just hearing the word 'exams' makes me sick~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ooh, Sensei！ Doesn't being in Takamura Class mean we don't have to take exams or anything~？」

name: Iori
message: 「Nope. Like I told Ririmu before, if anything, you could say the bar is even higher than in a normal class.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whaaat~？！ N-Nobody told me anything about that！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I’ve explained this many times already, haven't I？ Setsugekka, you weren't listening to me again, were you？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, wait, wait, Kei-chan! I just remembered! I remembered it just now, so that doesn't count!」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Honestly...」
There are evaluation exams for both Enbu and live combat.
Enbu, which literally involves showing off sword forms, actually has a lot of depth. There are even competitions that focus on them, so it's considered just as important as live combat.
In these competitions, you’re required to have not just accuracy, but movements that captivate the audience. Things like fluidity, timing of the 'initiation,' and so on.

name: Iori
message: 「Usually, things like the 'Shirasagi' or 'Ama-no-Uzume' styles used in festivals and ceremonies are the assigned tasks. It’s expected if you’re into Jindou.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, Enbu is just memorizing the forms, so everyone should be fine.」
They are used to express etiquette and to celebrate.
You could say it’s a mindset of never forgetting to pray to the eight million gods. They are sometimes performed for audiences during large tournaments.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, why did you look away？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh？ Oh, no, it’s nothing.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Enbu is that thing, right? Where you strike a sharp pose with a sword. Like, *hiyah*！」
……Something’s fishy.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, here’s a question for you, Setsugekka！」

name: Iori
message: 「Which of the following does not derive from the third stance of the Shirasagi form！ One, left and right Kesa-giri. Two, Yokote-barai. Three, Retraction-cut.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmph, don’t underestimate me. If you practice Jindou, even a kid would know that much.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「……So, Kei-chan. What’s the answer？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Figure it out yourself.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, you’re just pulling the rug out from under me here？ That’s not fair~！」

name: Iori
message: 「……You don’t actually know, do you？」
This question is supposed to be the absolute basics of Enbu, but...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A-auuuu……！？ Uh, ummm……」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Secchan, do you really not know？ Why don't you try actually performing the form？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Th-that’s it！！ Um, the third stance goes like this, and then you do this, and then that……！」

name: Momiji
message: 「There was a dance that used only your hands like that, wasn't there.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Right, right, pitter-patter-patter... wait, that’s not it！」
She starts dancing while still seated, gesticulating wildly. The correct answer is 3, but isn't Setsugekka the only one who doesn't get it？

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, I got it！ The answer is... 1！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Bzzzt！ Kazamine Setsugekka, you’re out.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wha, how come！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahaha, she actually got it wrong！ You’ve gotta be kidding me~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ughhh... there might still be a chance I’m actually right, you know...」

name: Iori
message: 「Looks like an unexpected tough opponent has appeared...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「There’s no need to worry that much. Setsugekka doesn't learn with her head, she learns with her body.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「She almost always gets it right in practice.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s right, Kei-chan said it best! I’ll just go ‘hiya!’ and ‘acho!’ and get it done!」

name: Iori
message: 「W-well, maybe we’ll have you demonstrate it sometime.」
I'm a little uneasy, but well, if Keisetsu says so, I'll take her word for it.

name: Iori
message: 「Now, as for the final practical evaluation, it’s exactly as it sounds.」

name: Iori
message: 「In the exam, you’ll be sparring against your classmates—in other words, other first-years in the Martial Arts Division—and be evaluated accordingly.」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s not just about winning or losing; every piece of data during the match will be evaluated, so don't you dare let your guard down.」

name: Iori
message: 「That concludes the Martial Arts Division midterm exam. Any questions？」
Yeah, a few of them look like their souls have left their bodies...

name: Iori
message: 「Now, here is where it gets real. The important thing is that this practical evaluation also serves as the selection process for the Martial Festival qualifiers.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, I know that！ Basically, as long as I win, I’m good, right?」

name: Iori
message: 「Simply put, yes. If you don't get results in this midterm, you won't even make it to the qualifiers, let alone the main tournament.」

name: Iori
message: 「Honestly, I have to say that it’s looking pretty tough for the current members of Takamura Class to even reach the qualifiers.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehhhhh！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Seriously！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「N-no way, why！？ I heard that if I win my match in the exam, I’d get to go to the qualifiers！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way！ I'm stronger than the kids in the other classes！ I can go fight them right now, you know？」

name: Iori
message: 「I know everyone's capabilities well. You all possess talent that stands out even among the first-years.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then why are you being so strict？」

name: Iori
message: 「The problem is the poor reputation of the Takamura Class.」

name: Iori
message: 「Because only a small fraction of students from the Martial Arts Division are able to compete in the Martial Festival qualifiers, you see.」

name: Iori
message: 「If I were to get students from the Takamura Class in there, they would have to show enough skill to overturn those bad rumors.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I've heard that the teachers and assistant teachers in charge of each class have the right to nominate students for the qualifying round, though...」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I have the right to nominate you all.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well then, that means everything's A-OK if you just nominate us, Teach？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, that alone won't be enough. All I have is the right to nominate students, you see.」

name: Iori
message: 「The same applies to the main tournament, but the Martial Festival qualifiers have a set number of entry spots from the start.」

name: Iori
message: 「The selection committee decides who makes it into the qualifying round from the pool of nominated students.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you aren't recognized here, you won't be able to participate in the qualifiers.」

name: Iori
message: 「In other words, it's entirely possible that the selection committee might exclude everyone in the Takamura Class from the qualifiers, using our reputation as an excuse.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Eeeh~, there's nothing we can do about that！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, *sniff*... Waaaaah！ I broke that wall the other day, I'm definitely doomed！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, you brought that on yourself, didn't you?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oooooh, if that's the case, I'm taking Momimomi down with me！ I'm gonna leak the video of Suzaku Hyper Dry！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Stop it, that's such a dirty move.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Shut uuuup！ Go to hell with me！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Both of you, it'll be fine. I'll figure something out.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, for real？」

name: Asahi
message: 「If I dig up some dirt on the selection committee and then ask them kindly and politely, I'm sure they'll let you into the qualifiers.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「As expected, Asahi-chan is so reliable at times like this!」

name: Iori
message: 「……Asahi, no cheating allowed, got it？ If you do, I won’t recommend you for the preliminary team.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ugh, my brilliant plan has been crushed……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You’re such a cheapskate, Sensei！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Anyway, we have to show enough results in the midterm exams to overturn our bad reputation.」

name: Momiji
message: 「We just need to produce results so good that if you cut us from the preliminary team, people will suspect foul play, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that’s exactly it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I see！ So basically, we just have to try our best！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Roger that! Let’s do our best then!」

name: Setsugekka & Ririmu
message: 「Yeah！」
Setsugekka and Ririmu high-five each other.

name: Momiji
message: 「Zero specificity, my head’s starting to spin……」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, I envy how happy those two are inside their heads.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Will this class be okay, I wonder.」

name: Iori
message: 「W-well, I’m sure it’ll be fine…… maybe.」
It feels like a rocky road ahead, but at least the current issues have been shared.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright everyone, let’s do our best for the midterm exams！」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah！」
Everyone raised their fists in the air, and the Takamura Class lesson began.
